<script>
const search = document.getElementById("photo-search");
const openButton = document.getElementById("open-search-results");

let matchedPhotos = [];
let searchGallery = null;

search.addEventListener("input", function () {
  const term = this.value.toLowerCase().trim();

  matchedPhotos = [];

  document.querySelectorAll(".photo-item").forEach(function (item) {
    const caption = item.dataset.caption.toLowerCase();

    if (term !== "" && caption.includes(term)) {
      const img = item.querySelector("img");

      if (img) {
        matchedPhotos.push({
          href: img.src,
          type: "image",
          description: img.alt
        });
      }
    }
  });

openButton.textContent =
  "View " + matchedPhotos.length + " matching photos";

openButton.disabled = matchedPhotos.length === 0;
});

openButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
  if (matchedPhotos.length === 0) return;

  if (searchGallery) {
    searchGallery.destroy();
  }

  searchGallery = GLightbox({
    elements: matchedPhotos,
    loop: true
  });

  searchGallery.open();
});
</script>
